Facts:
- Ossbridge’s 2025 population was 52,904 and its area was 1,284.6 km². [NR-01]
- Ossford’s 2025 population was 30,982 and its area was 846.2 km². [NR-02]

Calculations:
- Ossbridge density = 52,904 ÷ 1,284.6 = 41.183 residents/km².
- Ossford density = 30,982 ÷ 846.2 = 36.613 residents/km².
- Difference = 41.183 − 36.613 = 4.570 residents/km².

ANSWER: Ossbridge | 4.570
